criteria.evidence: ci-results.json: AC-075 exitCode 0, TAP '# tests 21 / # pass 21 / # fail 0 / # cancelled 0 / # skipped 0 / # todo 0', last line 'AC-075 OK'. Level mapping lib/identity.mjs:17-24; failed-first lib/identity.mjs:132; calls[] fields lib/providers/call.mjs:240-255; whitelist views lib/contract/views.mjs:80-117. The tests pass, but independent probing found a redaction gap: lib/identity.mjs:30 USER_DIR_RE has no i flag, so classifyIdentity on rollout file 'c:\users\alice\r.jsonl' returns evidence.path unchanged (username leaks), and '/HOME/bob/r.jsonl' also leaks. This violates design.md 11.2 (evidence must not contain the username).

findings.summary: USER_DIR_RE is case-sensitive, so lowercase users/home path segments are not redacted
findings.evidence: Probe: classifyIdentity with rollout file 'c:\users\alice\r.jsonl' gives evidence.path 'c:\users\alice\r.jsonl'; '/HOME/bob/r.jsonl' is also unchanged.
findings.fix: Add the i flag to USER_DIR_RE and add a lowercase or mixed-case test.

findings.summary: A user name containing a space is only partly redacted
findings.fix: For Windows paths, redact up to the next separator rather than stopping at whitespace, and add a test.

findings.summary: The Session compatibility regression command has no orchestrator execution evidence
findings.evidence: ci-results.json has passed:1/total:1 and covers only the first AC-075 command. The second command (session.test.mjs + session-invalidation.test.mjs) is backed only by the 26/26 claim in impl.md. The code shows no contradiction.
findings.fix: Include the second command's result in the next CI run.
